PACKAGE SCOPE AND PROVENANCE

The permission above applies to the original GLB geometry, rig, animation
data, generated preview renders, documentation and authoring source in this
package, to the extent intellectual property rights exist in those outputs.
They were generated specifically for the requesting user's research project
with AI assistance. No stock character, third-party motion capture, downloaded
exercise model, branded clothing or third-party barbell asset was incorporated.
This notice does not assert exclusive copyright in AI-generated outputs.

You may embed the GLBs in an offline research dashboard, modify them and
distribute the resulting application. Keep this license notice with a
distributed application or asset package, for example in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES
or a licenses directory. An on-screen credit is not required by this notice.

Python, NumPy, SciPy, Pillow, the C++ toolchain and FFmpeg were used as
production tools. Their code/binaries are not included in this package and
are not runtime dependencies of the GLBs. The preview title overlays use
DejaVu Sans; no font file is included in the GLBs or package.

The animations are original authored prototypes, not motion capture,
professional exercise certification, medical advice or biomechanical
validation. The numerical contact checks establish only the tested geometric
properties, not the safety or correctness of a person's exercise technique.
